data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for running Ultralytics YOLO computer vision models on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Runs Ultralytics YOLO models for single-image and real-time camera inference across Android and iOS. Supports object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, classification, pose estimation, and oriented bounding boxes.
use_when: You need to run YOLO object detection or computer vision tasks in a Flutter app
You want support for live camera inference using YOLOView
You want automatic discovery and downloading of official YOLO model assets
avoid_when: You require text recognition or generic machine learning tasks not suited for YOLO models
You want an on-device LLM package instead of computer vision
strengths: Supports multiple YOLO tasks including detection, segmentation, pose, and depth estimation
Provides both single-image inference and real-time camera preview widgets
Handles automatic model discovery, download, and caching
weaknesses: Requires specific native Gradle configurations and platform runtimes for optimal acceleration (like QNN)
Agpl-3.0 license may restrict commercial usage depending on your application structure
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration such as Android minSdkVersion 24, and optional native runtime additions if using Qualcomm NPU (QNN) models.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_commons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use Google ML Kit for on-device machine learning tasks without custom YOLO weights.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use raw TensorFlow Lite interpreter bindings for general custom TFLite models instead of Ultralytics YOLO specifically.
